scanNote:
KITOBNING BAHOLASH RAQAMLARIDA NOMUVOFIQLIK BOR (javoblarga ta'sir qilmaydi):
(1) 2-mashqda 8 ta bo'sh joy bor, lekin '(10 marks)' deb yozilgan.
(2) 3-mashqda 10 ta bo'sh joy bor (2 va 8-bandlarda ikkitadan), lekin '(8 marks)' deb yozilgan. Ro'yxatda 8 ta predlog bor, ya'ni 'on' va 'for' IKKI martadan ishlatiladi.
(3) 5-mashqdagi jadvalda 21 ta bo'sh katak bor, lekin '(7 marks)' deb yozilgan (ehtimol har 3 katak = 1 ball).

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word or phrase. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'z yoki iborani tanlang. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  famous
   2  tip
   3  food pills
   4  aluminium cans
   5  went
   6  crowded
   7  handmade
   8  kiss
   9  light
  10  traditional


HAR BIRI QAYSI BETDAN:

  1, 6, 7, 10 — Unit 13 (sayohat)
  2, 8       — Unit 14 (odob qoidalari)
  3          — Unit 13 (kelajak)
  4, 9       — Unit 14 (atrof-muhit)
  5          — Unit 13 (sayohat fe'llari)


⚠ ENG NOZIK BANDLAR:

  5  'I WENT on a boat trip.'
     ⚠ 'go ON a trip' — turg'un ibora.
     'ride' faqat ot, tuya, velosipedda
     ('ride a camel' — 104-bet).
     Qayiqda 'ride' ishlatilmaydi.

 10  'a TRADITIONAL restaurant'
     ⚠ 'delicious' faqat OVQAT haqida!
        'delicious food'       ✓
        'a delicious restaurant' ✗
     Restoran an'anaviy bo'lishi mumkin,
     mazali emas.

  9  'You mustn't LIGHT fires.'
     ⚠ 'to light a fire' = olov YOQMOQ
        'to burn' = yonmoq / kuydirmoq
     Olovni 'yoqish' — light.


ZID SO'ZLAR JUFTLARI:
  famous ↔ public
  tip ↔ gift
  pleasant ↔ crowded
  handmade ↔ clean
  light ↔ burn
  traditional ↔ delicious


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  famous     = mashhur
  a temple   = ibodatxona
  to tip     = choy pul bermoq
  a bellboy  = mehmonxona xizmatchisi
  a food pill = ovqat tabletkasi
  an oxygen mask = kislorod niqobi
  pre-packaged = oldindan qadoqlangan
  an aluminium can = alyuminiy banka
  a factory  = zavod
  crowded    = gavjum
  handmade   = qo'lda ishlangan
  a souvenir = sovg'a, esdalik
  to light a fire = olov yoqmoq
  traditional = an'anaviy

items.textEn: 1  Yesterday we visited a famous/public temple.
items.whyUz:
'a FAMOUS temple' = mashhur ibodatxona.

'public temple' tabiiy emas — ibodatxona
allaqachon ochiq joy.

'public' — 'public transport', 'in public'
kabi iboralarda ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 2  You should always tip/gift bellboys in the USA.
items.uz: AQShda mehmonxona xizmatchilariga doim choy pul berish kerak.
items.whyUz:
'to TIP somebody' = choy pul bermoq (FE'L).

'gift' — OT (sovg'a), fe'l sifatida bu
ma'noda ishlatilmaydi.

Unit 14 (98-bet): AQShda choy pul berish odat.

items.textEn: 3  In the year 2050 there will be food pills/oxygen masks instead of fresh food.
items.uz: 2050-yilda yangi ovqat o'rniga ovqat tabletkalari bo'ladi.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'instead of FRESH FOOD' — ovqat
o'rniga.

Ovqat o'rniga OVQAT TABLETKASI keladi,
kislorod niqobi emas.

Unit 13 — kelajak haqidagi bashoratlar.

items.textEn: 4  A lot of factories today use old pre-packaged food/aluminium cans to make new things.
items.uz: Bugun ko'p zavodlar yangi buyumlar yasash uchun eski alyuminiy bankalardan foydalanadi.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'to make NEW THINGS' — qayta ishlash.

ESKI BANKALARDAN yangi buyum yasaladi.
Eski OVQATDAN yangi buyum yasalmaydi!

Unit 14 (99-bet) — qayta ishlash (recycling).

items.textEn: 5  When I was in London I went/rode on a boat trip.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'go ON a trip' — TURG'UN IBORA.
  'went on a boat trip'  ✓
  'rode on a boat trip'  ✗

'ride' faqat ot, tuya, velosiped, mototsikl
uchun ('I rode a camel' — 104-bet).

items.textEn: 6  'Did you have a good time at the museum?'  'No, it was noisy and pleasant/crowded.'
items.uz: 'Muzeyda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdingizmi?' 'Yo'q, shovqinli va gavjum edi.'
items.whyUz:
KALIT: javob 'NO' bilan boshlanadi va
'NOISY' (shovqinli) — SALBIY.

'pleasant' (yoqimli) — IJOBIY, 'no' ga zid.
'crowded' (gavjum) — salbiy, mos keladi.

items.textEn: 7  We bought some handmade/clean souvenirs.
items.uz: Biz qo'lda ishlangan sovg'alar sotib oldik.
items.whyUz:
'HANDMADE souvenirs' = qo'lda ishlangan
esdaliklar — sayyohlar sotib oladigan narsa.

'clean souvenirs' — mantiqsiz (sovg'a toza
yoki iflos bo'lishi asosiy xususiyat emas).

items.textEn: 8  You shouldn't talk/kiss anyone in public in China.
items.uz: Xitoyda ommaviy joyda hech kimni o'pmaslik kerak.
items.whyUz:
Unit 14 (98-bet) — Xitoy odob qoidalari:
ommaviy joyda o'pish mumkin emas.

'talk' mantiqsiz — gaplashish hamma joyda
mumkin!

'in public' = ommaviy joyda.

items.textEn: 9  You mustn't light/burn fires in the forest.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to LIGHT a fire' = olov YOQMOQ
  (turg'un birikma)

'to burn' = yonmoq; kuydirmoq
  'The house is BURNING.' (yonyapti)
  'He BURNED the papers.' (qog'ozlarni
   kuydirdi)

Olovni 'yoqish' uchun DOIM 'light'.
light → lit → lit (noto'g'ri fe'l).

items.textEn: 10  We had dinner at a traditional/delicious restaurant last night.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'DELICIOUS' faqat OVQAT haqida!
  'delicious food'         ✓
  'a delicious restaurant' ✗

Restoran AN'ANAVIY bo'lishi mumkin, lekin
'mazali' bo'lolmaydi — ovqat mazali bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words/phrases below to fill in the gaps. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'z va iboralardan bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta):
  ballet lessons, a wonderful time, tell jokes,
  headache, join a gym, drop, public transport,
  washing-up liquid


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  washing-up liquid
  2  headache
  3  join a gym
  4  a wonderful time
  5  tell jokes
  6  ballet lessons
  7  drop
  8  public transport


⚠ KITOB BAHOSIDAGI NOMUVOFIQLIK:
  Mashqda 8 ta bo'sh joy bor, lekin
  '(10 marks)' deb yozilgan.
  Bu — kitobning kichik xatosi, javoblarga
  ta'sir qilmaydi.


⚠ ENG NOZIK BANDLAR — 1 va 8:

  Ikkalasida ham 'use / travel by' bor,
  shuning uchun chalkashish oson:

  1  'We should USE LESS ......... to help
      protect THE ENVIRONMENT.'
     → WASHING-UP LIQUID
     Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun idish
     yuvish suyuqligini KAMROQ ishlatish
     kerak (Unit 14, 99-bet).

     ⚠ 'public transport' BU YERDA XATO —
     jamoat transportini KAMROQ emas,
     KO'PROQ ishlatish kerak!

  8  'My father usually TRAVELS BY .........'
     → PUBLIC TRANSPORT
     'travel BY public transport' — turg'un
     birikma.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 2  'I've got a terrible ......... I'll take
    an ASPIRIN.'
    KALIT: aspirin — bosh og'rig'i dorisi.
    → HEADACHE

 3  'I want to KEEP FIT. Why don't you
    ......... ?'
    KALIT: 'keep fit' = sport bilan
    shug'ullanmoq.
    → JOIN A GYM (Workbook 57-bet)

 4  'We HAD ......... in Portugal.'
    KALIT: 'have a wonderful time' — turg'un
    ibora.
    → A WONDERFUL TIME

 5  'It's not a good idea to ......... to
    people you don't know IN CHINA.'
    KALIT: Xitoy odob qoidasi (Unit 14).
    → TELL JOKES

 6  'Mary is taking ......... because she
    wants to become A BALLERINA.'
    KALIT: ballerina — balet raqqosasi.
    → BALLET LESSONS

 7  'Do not ......... RUBBISH in the street —
    use a RUBBISH BIN instead.'
    KALIT: axlat.
    → DROP ('drop rubbish' = axlat tashlamoq)


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU ...?':
  'Why don't you JOIN a gym?' — TAKLIF.
  Keyin ASOSIY shakl.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE LESSONS':
  'to take lessons' = darsga qatnamoq
  'to take ballet/piano/driving lessons'


DIQQAT — 'DROP':
  'to drop rubbish' = axlat tashlamoq
     (yerga tashlab ketmoq)
  'to drop something' = tushirib yubormoq


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  washing-up liquid = idish yuvish suyuqligi
  the environment = atrof-muhit
  to protect  = himoya qilmoq
  a headache  = bosh og'rig'i
  an aspirin  = aspirin
  to keep fit = sog'lom qolmoq
  to join a gym = sport zaliga yozilmoq
  a wonderful time = ajoyib vaqt
  to tell jokes = hazil aytmoq
  ballet lessons = balet darslari
  a ballerina = balet raqqosasi
  to drop rubbish = axlat tashlamoq
  a rubbish bin = axlat qutisi
  public transport = jamoat transporti

items.sentence: 1  We should use less .............................. to help protect the environment.
items.uz: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun kamroq idish yuvish suyuqligi ishlatishimiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND!

KALIT: 'use LESS' + 'protect the ENVIRONMENT'.
Unit 14, 99-bet — atrof-muhitni himoya qilish.

'public transport' BU YERDA XATO — jamoat
transportini KAMROQ emas, KO'PROQ ishlatish
kerak!

items.sentence: 2  I've got a terrible ....................... . I'll take an aspirin.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: ASPIRIN — bosh og'rig'i dorisi.

'a terrible headache' = qattiq bosh og'rig'i.
'I've got a headache' — turg'un ibora.

items.sentence: 3  'I want to keep fit.'  'Why don't you ..................... ?'

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'KEEP FIT' = sport bilan
shug'ullanmoq (Workbook 57-bet).

'Why don't you ...?' — TAKLIF, keyin ASOSIY
shakl ('Why don't you JOIN').

KALIT: 'HAVE a ... time' — turg'un ibora.

'have a wonderful/good/great time'
= yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq

1-mashqning 6-bandida ham bor edi:
'Did you HAVE A GOOD TIME?'

items.sentence: 5  I don't think it's a good idea to ..................................... to people you don't know in China.
items.uz: Xitoyda tanimagan odamlarga hazil aytish yaxshi fikr emas deb o'ylayman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'IN CHINA' — Unit 14 odob qoidalari
(98-bet).

'to TELL a joke' — 'say' emas!
  tell a joke / tell a story / tell the truth
  say something / say hello

items.sentence: 6  Mary is taking ........................................... because she wants to become a ballerina.
items.uz: Meri balet darslariga qatnayapti, chunki u ballerina bo'lmoqchi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: BALLERINA = balet raqqosasi.

'to TAKE lessons' = darsga qatnamoq
(take ballet / piano / driving lessons).

items.sentence: 7  Do not ............................. rubbish in the street — use a rubbish bin instead.
items.uz: Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang — buning o'rniga axlat qutisidan foydalaning.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: RUBBISH va RUBBISH BIN.

'to DROP rubbish' = axlat tashlamoq
(yerga tashlab ketmoq).

Unit 14, 99-bet — atrof-muhit qoidalari.

KALIT: 'travel BY ...' — transport vositasi
keladi.

'travel BY public transport' — artiklsiz
(by car, by bus, by train kabi).

Grammar 66-bet: 'by' + transport — artikl
qo'yilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prepositions below to fill in the gaps. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi predloglardan bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta predlog):
  with, to, at, on, for, in, from, into


⚠ MUHIM: 10 TA BO'Sh JOY, 8 TA PREDLOG!
  2 va 8-bandlarda IKKITADAN bo'sh joy bor.
  Demak 'ON' va 'FOR' IKKI MARTA
  ishlatiladi.

  Kitob '(8 marks)' deb yozgan, lekin
  bo'sh joylar 10 ta — kichik nomuvofiqlik.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  FOR
  2  TO ... AT
  3  IN
  4  WITH
  5  INTO
  6  FROM
  7  ON
  8  ON ... FOR


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  'You should never be late FOR
     appointments.'

 2  'My sister is flying TO Toronto AT 8
     o'clock.'

 3  'I live IN the city centre.'

 4  'Don't talk WITH your mouth full, Tom.'

 5  'You mustn't throw plastic bottles INTO
     the sea.'

 6  'They came back FROM their holidays a
     week ago.'

 7  'You will go ON a short journey this
     week.'

 8  'Alex and Jo are going ON holiday FOR a
     whole month.'


TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR — YODLASh KERAK:

  be late FOR      = ... ga kechikmoq
  fly TO           = ... ga uchmoq
  AT 8 o'clock     = soat 8 da
  live IN          = ... da yashamoq
  talk WITH your mouth full
                   = og'iz to'la gaplashmoq
  throw INTO       = ... ning ichiga tashlamoq
  come back FROM   = ... dan qaytmoq
  go ON a journey  = sayohatga chiqmoq
  go ON holiday    = ta'tilga chiqmoq
  FOR a month      = bir oy davomida


⚠ 'IN' va 'INTO' FARQI:

  IN   = ichida (JOY — harakat yo'q)
     'I live IN the city centre.'

  INTO = ichiga (HARAKAT — tashqaridan
         ichkariga)
     'Don't throw bottles INTO the sea.'

  Shuning uchun 5-bandda 'in' emas, 'INTO'!


⚠ 'FOR' NING IKKI MA'NOSI:

  1-band: 'be late FOR' — turg'un birikma
  8-band: 'FOR a whole month' — DAVOMIYLIK
     (Unit 15: for/since qoidasi)


⚠ 'ON' NING IKKI ISHLATILIShI:

  7-band: 'go ON a journey' (sayohat)
  8-band: 'go ON holiday' (ta'til — artiklsiz)

  DIQQAT: 'go on HOLIDAY' — artikl YO'Q,
  lekin 'go on A journey' — artikl BOR.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an appointment = uchrashuv (belgilangan)
  the city centre = shahar markazi
  a mouth     = og'iz
  a plastic bottle = plastik shisha
  to throw    = tashlamoq
  to come back = qaytmoq
  a journey   = sayohat
  a whole month = butun bir oy

items.sentence: 1  You should never be late ................. appointments.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'be late FOR something' — TURG'UN BIRIKMA.
  be late FOR school / work / an appointment

'late to' XATO.

items.sentence: 2  My sister is flying .............. Toronto .............. 8 o'clock.  (IKKI bo'sh joy: birinchisi)

commonMistake.whyUz:
'fly TO a place' — yo'nalish predlogi 'to'.
  fly to / go to / travel to / drive to

DIQQAT: 'arrive IN a city' (arrive to XATO).

items.sentence: 2  My sister is flying to Toronto .............. 8 o'clock.  (IKKI bo'sh joy: ikkinchisi)

commonMistake.whyUz:
SOAT bilan DOIM 'AT':
  AT 8 o'clock / AT noon / AT midnight

Solishtiring:
  AT + soat;  ON + kun;  IN + oy/yil

items.sentence: 3  I live ................ the city centre.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'live IN a place' — joy predlogi.
  live IN London / IN the city centre

⚠ 'IN' — harakat YO'Q (5-banddagi 'into' bilan
solishtiring).

items.sentence: 4  'Don't talk ........................... your mouth full, Tom.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
'talk WITH your mouth full' — TURG'UN
IBORA (og'iz to'la gaplashmoq).

Unit 14 — dasturxon odobi.

Bu qurilma 'with + ot + sifat' deyiladi:
'with his hands in his pockets'.

items.sentence: 5  You mustn't throw plastic bottles ........................... the sea.
items.uz: Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlash mumkin emas.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'IN' va 'INTO' FARQI:
  IN = ichida (harakat YO'Q)
  INTO = ichiga (HARAKAT bor)

'throw ... INTO the sea' — shisha tashqaridan
dengiz ICHIGA boradi → INTO.

Unit 14, 99-bet — atrof-muhit.

items.sentence: 6  They came back ............................ their holidays a week ago.
items.uz: Ular bir hafta oldin ta'tildan qaytishdi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'come back FROM a place/holiday' = ... dan
qaytmoq.

'FROM' — kelib chiqish nuqtasi.
'a week ago' — Past Simple ko'rsatkichi.

items.sentence: 7  You will go ..................... a short journey this week.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'go ON a journey/trip' — TURG'UN IBORA.
  go on a journey / on a trip / on a tour

1-mashqning 5-bandi ham shu:
'I WENT ON a boat trip.'

items.sentence: 8  Alex and Jo are going .............. holiday .............. a whole month.  (IKKI bo'sh joy: birinchisi)
items.uz: Aleks va Jo butun bir oyga ta'tilga chiqishmoqda.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'go ON holiday' — TURG'UN IBORA.

⚠ DIQQAT: 'go on HOLIDAY' — artikl YO'Q,
lekin 'go on A journey' — artikl BOR (7-band).

items.sentence: 8  Alex and Jo are going on holiday .............. a whole month.  (IKKI bo'sh joy: ikkinchisi)
items.uz: Aleks va Jo butun bir oyga ta'tilga chiqishmoqda.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'FOR + DAVOMIYLIK' (qancha vaqt):
  for a month / for two years / for a week

Unit 15 qoidasi: FOR — davomiylik,
SINCE — boshlanish nuqtasi.

⚠ 'for' bu mashqda IKKI marta ishlatiladi
(1-band va 8-band).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words below to fill in the gaps. Then, use the phrases to write sentences, as in the example. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlardan bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring. So'ngra namunadagidek iboralar bilan gaplar tuzing. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta):
  chew, short, pre-packaged, find, huge, sore,
  earn, great

KITOB NAMUNASI:
  'John wants to FIND A BETTER JOB.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  to FIND a better job
  2  GREAT news
  3  to EARN money
  4  a SHORT trip
  5  PRE-PACKAGED food
  6  to CHEW gum
  7  a SORE throat
  8  HUGE temples


SO'ZLAR TURI BO'YIChA:

  FE'LLAR (oldida 'to' bor):
     1  find  (topmoq)
     3  earn  (topmoq — pul)
     6  chew  (chaynamoq)

  SIFATLAR (otdan oldin):
     2  great        (ajoyib)
     4  short        (qisqa)
     5  pre-packaged (qadoqlangan)
     7  sore         (og'riyotgan)
     8  huge         (ulkan)

  ⚠ QANDAY ANIQLANADI:
  1, 3, 6-bandlarda 'TO' bor → FE'L kerak.
  Qolganlarida ot bor → SIFAT kerak.


⚠ 'FIND' va 'EARN' FARQI:
  ikkalasi ham o'zbekchada 'topmoq':

  to FIND = topmoq (yo'qolgan/izlangan
     narsani)
     'find a job', 'find my keys'

  to EARN = ishlab topmoq (PUL)
     'earn money', 'earn a living'

  'find money' — yerdan pul topmoq!
  'earn money' — mehnat bilan topmoq.


GAP NAMUNALARI (har ibora bilan):

 1  'John wants to FIND A BETTER JOB.'
    (kitob namunasi)

 2  'I've got GREAT NEWS for you!'
    (Sizga ajoyib xabarim bor!)

 3  'He works hard to EARN MONEY.'
    (U pul topish uchun qattiq ishlaydi.)

 4  'We went on A SHORT TRIP to the
     mountains.'
    (Biz tog'larga qisqa sayohatga chiqdik.)

 5  'A lot of factories make PRE-PACKAGED
     FOOD.'
    (Ko'p zavodlar qadoqlangan ovqat
     ishlab chiqaradi.)

 6  'You mustn't CHEW GUM in class.'
    (Darsda saqich chaynash mumkin emas.)

 7  'I've got A SORE THROAT, so I can't
     sing.'
    (Tomog'im og'riyapti, shuning uchun
     kuylay olmayman.)

 8  'We visited HUGE TEMPLES in Thailand.'
    (Tailandda ulkan ibodatxonalarni
     ko'rdik.)


⚠ 'NEWS' — SANALMAYDIGAN:
  'GREAT NEWS' — artikl YO'Q!
     'great news'    ✓
     'a great news'  ✗

  Fe'l BIRLIKDA:
     'The news IS good.'  ✓
     'The news ARE good.' ✗


⚠ 'SORE' — FAQAT TANA A'ZOSI HAQIDA:
  a sore throat  = og'riyotgan tomoq
  sore eyes      = og'riyotgan ko'zlar
  sore feet      = og'riyotgan oyoqlar

  Umumiy 'og'riq' uchun: 'It HURTS.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to chew     = chaynamoq
  chewing gum = saqich
  short       = qisqa
  pre-packaged = oldindan qadoqlangan
  to find     = topmoq
  huge        = ulkan
  sore        = og'riyotgan
  a throat    = tomoq
  to earn     = ishlab topmoq
  great       = ajoyib
  news        = xabar (SANALMAYDIGAN)

items.sentence: 1  to ........... a better job   →   NAMUNA: John wants to find a better job.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KITOB NAMUNASI.

'TO' bor → FE'L kerak.

⚠ 'find' va 'earn' FARQI:
  find = topmoq (ish, kalit)
  earn = ishlab topmoq (PUL)

'news' — OT, oldiga SIFAT kerak → GREAT.

⚠ 'news' SANALMAYDIGAN: artikl YO'Q!
  'great news'   ✓
  'a great news' ✗

Fe'l BIRLIKDA: 'The news IS good.'

Namuna gap: 'I've got GREAT NEWS for you!'

'TO' bor → FE'L kerak.

⚠ 'EARN money' = mehnat bilan pul topmoq.
'find money' — yerdan pul topib olmoq
(boshqa ma'no!).

6-mashqning 2-bandida ham bor:
'he wants to EARN extra money'.

Namuna gap: 'He works hard to EARN MONEY.'

'a ... trip' — artikl 'a' bor, ot bor →
SIFAT kerak → SHORT.

3-mashqning 7-bandida ham bor:
'a SHORT journey'.

Namuna gap: 'We went on A SHORT TRIP to the
mountains.'

'food' — OT, oldiga SIFAT kerak.

'PRE-PACKAGED food' = qadoqlangan ovqat.
'pre-' = oldindan (prefiks).

1-mashqning 4-bandida ham bor edi.

Namuna gap: 'A lot of factories make
PRE-PACKAGED FOOD.'

'TO' bor → FE'L kerak → CHEW.

'chewing gum' = saqich
'to chew gum' = saqich chaynamoq

Coursebook 102-bet, 13a-mashq:
'You mustn't CHEW GUM in class.'

Namuna gap shu.

'a ... throat' → SIFAT kerak → SORE.

⚠ 'sore' faqat TANA A'ZOSI haqida:
  a sore throat / sore eyes / sore feet

'I've got a sore throat' = tomog'im
og'riyapti.

Namuna gap: 'I've got A SORE THROAT, so I
can't sing.'

'temples' — OT (ko'plik), oldiga SIFAT
kerak → HUGE.

'huge' = ulkan (very big).

1-mashqning 1-bandida 'temple' bor edi.

Namuna gap: 'We visited HUGE TEMPLES in
Thailand.'

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the table below with the past simple and past participles of the verbs. (7 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvalni fe'llarning Past Simple va Past Participle shakllari bilan to'ldiring. (7 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  Infinitive   Past Simple   Past Participle
  ──────────────────────────────────────────
   1  be        WAS / WERE    BEEN
   2  buy       BOUGHT        bought (berilgan)
   3  call      called (ber.) CALLED
   4  do        DID           DONE
   5  go        WENT          gone (berilgan)
   6  have      HAD           HAD
   7  live      LIVED         LIVED
   8  return    returned(ber) RETURNED
   9  see       SAW           SEEN
  10  spend     SPENT         spent (berilgan)
  11  stay      STAYED        STAYED
  12  take      took (ber.)   TAKEN
  13  visit     VISITED       VISITED
  14  want      WANTED        wanted (berilgan)


⚠ KITOB BAHOSIDAGI NOMUVOFIQLIK:
  Jadvalda 21 ta bo'sh katak bor, lekin
  '(7 marks)' deb yozilgan
  (ehtimol har 3 katak = 1 ball).


IKKI GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (-ED qo'shiladi) — 6 ta:
     call   → called  → called
     live   → lived   → lived
     return → returned → returned
     stay   → stayed  → stayed
     visit  → visited → visited
     want   → wanted  → wanted

     ⚠ Ikkala shakl BIR XIL!

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR — 8 ta:
     be   → was/were → been
     buy  → bought   → bought
     do   → did      → done
     go   → went     → gone
     have → had      → had
     see  → saw      → seen
     spend → spent   → spent
     take → took     → taken


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLARNI GURUHLASh:

  UCh SHAKL HAM BIR XIL: (yo'q bu jadvalda)

  2 va 3-ShAKL BIR XIL — 4 ta:
     buy   → BOUGHT → BOUGHT
     have  → HAD    → HAD
     spend → SPENT  → SPENT

  UCh SHAKL HAM BOShQA — 5 ta:
     be   → WAS/WERE → BEEN
     do   → DID      → DONE
     go   → WENT     → GONE
     see  → SAW      → SEEN
     take → TOOK     → TAKEN


⚠ 'BE' — IKKI SHAKLI BOR:
  I / he / she / it   → WAS
  you / we / they     → WERE
  Past Participle     → BEEN (bitta)


⚠ 'BEEN' va 'GONE' FARQI (Unit 15!):
  'He has GONE to Paris.'
     → Parijda, HALI QAYTMAGAN
  'He has BEEN to Paris.'
     → Parijga borib KELGAN (tajriba)

  Grammar 65-bet, Workbook 61-bet.


⚠ '-ED' NING YOZILISh QOIDALARI:
  live  → livED   ('e' bor → faqat 'd')
  stay  → stayED  (unli + y → to'g'ridan)
  visit → visitED
  want  → wantED

  Solishtiring:
     study → studIED (undosh + y → i + ed)
     stop  → stopPED (bitta undosh ikkilanadi)


QAYERDA IShLATILADI:
  Past Simple      → Past Simple zamonda
  Past Participle  → Present Perfect da
                     (have/has + V3)

  'I VISITED Paris last year.' (Past Simple)
  'I HAVE VISITED Paris.' (Present Perfect)

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'be' — Past Simple da IKKI shakl:
  I/he/she/it → WAS
  you/we/they → WERE

Past Participle — bitta: BEEN.

⚠ 'has BEEN' = borib KELGAN (tajriba)
   'has GONE' = ketgan, hali qaytmagan

Jadvalda Past Participle BERILGAN: 'bought'.

⚠ 'buy' — 2 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
  buy → BOUGHT → BOUGHT

1-mashqning 7-bandi:
'We BOUGHT some handmade souvenirs.'

Jadvalda Past Simple BERILGAN: 'called'.

TO'G'RI fe'l → ikkala shakl BIR XIL:
call → CALLED → CALLED

⚠ UCH SHAKL HAM BOSHQA:
do → DID → DONE

'Have you DONE your homework?'
(Present Perfect — DONE)
'DID you do it?' (Past Simple — DID)

Jadvalda Past Participle BERILGAN: 'gone'.

⚠ UCH SHAKL HAM BOSHQA:
go → WENT → GONE

6-mashqning 10-bandi shu qoidaga oid:
'They have gone to the zoo YESTERDAY' — XATO.

⚠ 2 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
have → HAD → HAD

'I HAVE HAD a headache all day.'
(birinchi 'have' — yordamchi,
 ikkinchi 'had' — asosiy fe'l)

TO'G'RI fe'l → ikkala shakl BIR XIL.

⚠ YOZILISHI: 'live' oxirida 'e' bor →
faqat 'd' qo'shiladi: livED.

6-mashqning 1-bandi:
'Karen has LIVED here SINCE 1989.'

Jadvalda Past Simple BERILGAN: 'returned'.

TO'G'RI fe'l → ikkala shakl BIR XIL:
return → RETURNED → RETURNED

⚠ UCH SHAKL HAM BOSHQA:
see → SAW → SEEN

113-bet, 7-mashqning 3-bandi:
'they HAVE SEEN UFOs in the area'
(Present Perfect — SEEN).

Jadvalda Past Participle BERILGAN: 'spent'.

⚠ 2 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
spend → SPENT → SPENT

'spend money' = pul sarflamoq
'spend time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq

TO'G'RI fe'l → ikkala shakl BIR XIL.

⚠ YOZILISHI: UNLI + Y → to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
'-ed': stayED.

Solishtiring: UNDOSH + Y → i + ed
  study → studIED

Jadvalda Past Simple BERILGAN: 'took'.

⚠ UCH SHAKL HAM BOSHQA:
take → TOOK → TAKEN

113-bet, 1b-mashq:
'I don't remember TAKING them.'

TO'G'RI fe'l → ikkala shakl BIR XIL.

6-mashqning 5-bandi shu qoidaga oid:
'When HAVE YOU VISITED the museum?' — XATO,
'When DID you VISIT ...?' bo'lishi kerak.

Jadvalda Past Participle BERILGAN: 'wanted'.

TO'G'RI fe'l → ikkala shakl BIR XIL:
want → WANTED → WANTED

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  for      →  SINCE
   2  so       →  BECAUSE
   3  some     →  ANY
   4  There    →  IT
   5  have you visited → DID YOU VISIT
   6  must     →  MUSTN'T
   7  hasn't never travelled → HAS NEVER
                              TRAVELLED
   8  should   →  SHOULDN'T
   9  Has you sent → HAVE YOU SENT
  10  have gone →  WENT
  11  must     →  CAN
  12  cooks    →  IS COOKING


XATOLARNI TURLARGA BO'LISh:

  UNIT 15 (Present Perfect) — 1, 5, 7, 9, 10
  UNIT 14 (must/mustn't/should) — 6, 8, 11
  UNIT 13 (kelajak, some/any) — 2, 3, 4
  ZAMON tanlash — 12


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'Karen has lived here FOR 1989.'
    ⚠ 1989 — NUQTA (qachondan), DAVOMIYLIK
    emas.
       SINCE + boshlanish nuqtasi
          (since 1989, since Monday)
       FOR + davomiylik
          (for 3 years, for a month)
    → SINCE 1989

 2  '... in the holidays SO he wants to earn
     extra money.'
    ⚠ Pul topish — ishlashning SABABI, natijasi
    emas!
       [natija] BECAUSE [sabab]
    → BECAUSE
    (113-bet, 4-mashq — bir xil qoida)

 3  'There aren't SOME clouds in the sky.'
    ⚠ INKOR gapda 'any':
       tasdiq  → some
       inkor   → any
       savol   → any
    → ANY

 4  'THERE will be snowy in Montreal.'
    ⚠ Ob-havo haqida 'IT':
       'IT will be snowy/sunny/cold.'
       'THERE will be snow.' (ot bilan)
    'snowy' — SIFAT → 'it' kerak.
    → IT

 5  'When HAVE YOU VISITED the museum?'
    ⚠ 'WHEN' bilan Present Perfect
    IShLATILMAYDI!
    'when' aniq vaqt so'raydi → Past Simple.
    → DID YOU VISIT

 6  'You MUST smoke in hospitals.'
    ⚠ Mantiq: kasalxonada chekish TAQIQLANGAN!
       must    = shart
       mustn't = taqiqlangan
    → MUSTN'T

 7  'Sharon HASN'T NEVER TRAVELLED by plane.'
    ⚠ IKKI INKOR — ingliz tilida MUMKIN EMAS!
    'never' o'zi allaqachon inkor.
       'has NEVER travelled'  ✓
       'hasn't EVER travelled' ✓
       'hasn't never travelled' ✗
    → HAS NEVER TRAVELLED

 8  'You SHOULD use aerosols. They POLLUTE the
     air.'
    ⚠ Mantiq: aerozol havoni IFLOSLAYDI →
    ishlatMASLIK kerak.
    → SHOULDN'T

 9  'HAS YOU SENT the invitations yet?'
    ⚠ 'you' bilan DOIM 'have':
       I/you/we/they → HAVE
       he/she/it     → HAS
    → HAVE YOU SENT

10  'They HAVE GONE to the zoo YESTERDAY.'
    ⚠ 'yesterday' — ANIQ VAQT → Past Simple!
    Present Perfect da aniq vaqt BO'LMAYDI.
    → WENT

11  'Mum, MUST I have an ice-cream, please?'
    ⚠ Ruxsat SO'RASh uchun 'can', 'must' emas.
    'Must I ...?' = 'Majburmanmi?' — muzqaymoq
    yeyish majburiyat emas!
    'please' ham iltimosni ko'rsatadi.
    → CAN

12  'He COOKS dinner AT THE MOMENT.'
    ⚠ 'at the moment' — Present Continuous
    ko'rsatkichi!
    → IS COOKING


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO QILINADIGAN — 5-BAND:

  'WHEN' + Present Perfect — DOIMO XATO.

  Sababi: Present Perfect vaqtni AYTMAYDI,
  'when' esa aynan vaqtni SO'RAYDI.
  Ular bir-biriga zid!

     'WHEN DID you visit?'    ✓
     'HAVE you visited?'      ✓ (when yo'q)
     'When have you visited?' ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  extra money = qo'shimcha pul
  a cloud    = bulut
  snowy      = qorli
  to smoke   = chekmoq
  an aerosol = aerozol
  to pollute = ifloslantirmoq
  an invitation = taklifnoma
  a zoo      = hayvonot bog'i
  at the moment = hozir

items.textEn: 1  Karen has lived here FOR 1989.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 1989 — BOSHLANISH NUQTASI (qachondan),
davomiylik emas.

  SINCE + nuqta: since 1989, since Monday
  FOR + davomiylik: for 3 years, for a month

Unit 15 (Grammar 66-bet) qoidasi.

items.textEn: 2  Tim is going to work at the supermarket in the holidays SO he wants to earn extra money.
items.uz: Tim ta'tilda supermarketda ishlaydi, chunki qo'shimcha pul topmoqchi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ MANTIQ: pul topish — ishlashning SABABI,
natijasi emas!

  [natija] BECAUSE [sabab]  ✓
  [sabab] SO [natija]

113-bet, 4-mashqdagi bir xil qoida.

items.textEn: 3  There aren't SOME clouds in the sky. I don't think it's going to rain.
items.uz: Osmonda bulut yo'q. Yomg'ir yog'maydi deb o'ylayman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ INKOR gapda 'ANY':
  tasdiq → some
  inkor  → any
  savol  → any

'There AREN'T ANY clouds.' ✓

(Alternativa: 'There are NO clouds' — lekin
u holda 'aren't' ni ham o'zgartirish kerak.)

items.textEn: 4  THERE will be snowy in Montreal tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
⚠ OB-HAVO haqida DOIM 'IT':
  'IT will be snowy/sunny/cold/windy.'

'THERE' faqat OT bilan:
  'THERE will be SNOW.' (snow — ot)

'snowy' — SIFAT → 'IT' kerak.

items.textEn: 5  When HAVE YOU VISITED the museum?
items.whyUz:
⚠ ENG KO'P XATO QILINADIGAN QOIDA:
'WHEN' bilan Present Perfect ISHLATILMAYDI!

Sababi: Present Perfect vaqtni AYTMAYDI,
'when' esa aynan vaqtni SO'RAYDI — zid.

  'WHEN DID you visit?'    ✓
  'HAVE you visited?'      ✓ (when yo'q)
  'When have you visited?' ✗

items.textEn: 6  You MUST smoke in hospitals.
items.whyUz:
⚠ MANTIQ: kasalxonada chekish TAQIQLANGAN!

  must    = shart, majbur
  mustn't = TAQIQLANGAN

Unit 14 (Grammar 60-bet) — qonun va qoidalar.

items.textEn: 7  Sharon HASN'T NEVER TRAVELLED by plane.
items.whyUz:
⚠ IKKI INKOR — ingliz tilida MUMKIN EMAS!
'never' o'zi allaqachon inkor ma'nosida.

  'has NEVER travelled'    ✓
  'hasn't EVER travelled'  ✓
  'hasn't never travelled' ✗

Unit 15 (Grammar 66-bet) — never + Present
Perfect.

items.textEn: 8  You SHOULD use aerosols. They pollute the air.
items.uz: Aerozollardan foydalanmaslik kerak. Ular havoni ifloslantiradi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ MANTIQ: ikkinchi gap 'They POLLUTE the air'
(havoni ifloslantiradi) — SALBIY sabab.

Demak maslahat INKOR bo'lishi kerak:
'You SHOULDN'T use aerosols.'

Unit 14, 99-bet — atrof-muhit.

items.textEn: 9  HAS YOU SENT the invitations yet?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'YOU' bilan DOIM 'HAVE':
  I / you / we / they → HAVE
  he / she / it       → HAS

'HAVE YOU SENT ... YET?' ✓

'yet' — savol va inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA
(Unit 15).

items.textEn: 10  They HAVE GONE to the zoo yesterday.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'YESTERDAY' — ANIQ VAQT → Past Simple!

Present Perfect da ANIQ VAQT BO'LMAYDI:
  'They WENT yesterday.'      ✓
  'They HAVE GONE.'           ✓ (vaqtsiz)
  'They have gone yesterday.' ✗

go → WENT → gone

items.textEn: 11  Mum, MUST I have an ice-cream, please?
items.whyUz:
⚠ RUXSAT SO'RASH uchun 'CAN', 'must' emas!

'MUST I ...?' = 'Majburmanmi?' — muzqaymoq
yeyish majburiyat emas, iltimos.

'PLEASE' ham iltimosni ko'rsatadi.

'Can I ...?' / 'Could I ...?' / 'May I ...?'
— ruxsat so'rash (Grammar 60-63-betlar).

items.textEn: 12  He COOKS dinner at the moment.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'AT THE MOMENT' — Present Continuous
ko'rsatkichi!

Hozir, ayni damda sodir bo'layotgan ish
→ am/is/are + V-ing.

Boshqa ko'rsatkichlar: now, right now,
at present, look!, listen!

groups.explanationUz: Uchta shakl: Infinitive — Past Simple — Past Participle.

groups.ruleUz: TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (5-mashq) — ikkala shakl BIR XIL

patterns.exampleEn: Karen has lived here since 1989. She has lived here for many years.
patterns.exampleUz: Keren 1989-yildan beri shu yerda yashaydi. U ko'p yillardan beri shu yerda yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
SINCE + boshlanish nuqtasi (1989, Monday);
FOR + davomiylik (3 years, a month).

patterns.exampleEn: When did you visit the museum?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'WHEN' bilan Present Perfect ISHLATILMAYDI.
'When have you visited?' — DOIM XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: Sharon has never travelled by plane.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IKKI INKOR MUMKIN EMAS:
'hasn't never' ✗ → 'has never' ✓
yoki 'hasn't ever' ✓

patterns.formula: IT WILL BE + [ob-havo sifati].   /   THERE WILL BE + [ot].
patterns.exampleEn: It will be snowy in Montreal. There will be snow in Montreal.
patterns.exampleUz: Monrealda qorli bo'ladi. Monrealda qor bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ob-havo SIFATI bilan → IT;
ob-havo OTI bilan → THERE.

patterns.exampleEn: You mustn't smoke in hospitals. You shouldn't use aerosols.
patterns.exampleUz: Kasalxonada chekish mumkin emas. Aerozol ishlatmaslik kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
MUSTN'T — qat'iy taqiq (qonun);
SHOULDN'T — maslahat (yaxshi emas).

patterns.exampleEn: Mum, can I have an ice-cream, please?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ruxsat so'rash — CAN/COULD/MAY.
'Must I ...?' = 'Majburmanmi?' — boshqa ma'no.

patterns.exampleEn: He is cooking dinner at the moment.
